_doc: Variant of every flyover, bridge, viaduct, rail stretch and foot bridge of the bake (P2-034, the infrastructure kits). Ids are the variants of harness/design/reference/infrastructure/ (variant_map.md); the game builds each from its kit (game/world/infra/). road: OSM way of a strip -> variant (from variant_map.json, P2-033); a structure strip on no listed way takes roadDefaults by what it is (a deck over water, over a railway, a short service bridge, a ramp on fill, else by class). rail: OSM way -> variant, else railDefaults by layer and tags. metro: the elevated metro (both tracks on one box, Phase I, decided P2-034) and the ramps. footBridges: foot bridge id -> variant, else the default. Hand edits go here with a reason in _why.

_why.MET-VB1: P2-034, 2026-11-14: the pilot Blue Line east of Mandi House to Indraprastha opened in 2006 as part of Phase I; metro.md puts the Phase I Blue Line under MET-VB1 (single box, Y piers), so the open item 4 of variant_map.md is settled as VB1 until a photo says otherwise.
_why.eras: The FLY-T1 and FLY-B1 split of the named flyovers stays as variant_map.md inferred it (item 1 of its verify list); a photo check per flyover is a follow-up.
_why.skyline: P2-034, 2026-11-14: the Signature Bridge (bridges.md BRI-Y2, Wazirabad, outside the baked pilot) stands on the skyline north of the old city as a far piece; its point and bearing are estimates [E] from the map of the Wazirabad crossing (deck about east-north-east), to check against imagery when the north block is baked.
_why.BRI-Y1: P2-034, 2026-11-14: item 2 of variant_map.md checked on Esri imagery (harness/reports/infra/vikas_marg_bridge_site.png): the Vikas Marg crossing at the ITO barrage is two parallel decks with a gap between them (the OSM primary and secondary ways), multi-span girders on wall piers in the river; both stay BRI-Y1.
